# ZDNET

> ZDNET publishes technology news, product reviews, buying advice, and practical how-to guidance for professionals and consumers.

ZDNET covers enterprise IT, AI, cybersecurity, cloud, software, devices, and digital lifestyle topics with a mix of reporting, analysis, reviews, and service journalism. Its content spans breaking tech news, hands-on product testing, business technology trends, and step-by-step advice for using and securing modern tools.

## Core Coverage
- [News](https://www.zdnet.com/news/): Latest reporting on technology, business, security, AI, and digital transformation.
- [Reviews](https://www.zdnet.com/reviews/): Hands-on reviews of laptops, phones, software, TVs, wearables, and accessories.
- [How To](https://www.zdnet.com/article/): Practical explainers and tutorials for apps, devices, security, and productivity workflows.
- [Best Lists](https://www.zdnet.com/article/best/): Expert-tested recommendations and buying guides across major tech categories.
- [Deals](https://www.zdnet.com/deals/): Curated discounts on laptops, phones, software, smart home gear, and accessories.
- [Videos](https://www.zdnet.com/videos/): Video coverage of product launches, reviews, interviews, and technology trends.

## Technology News
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/): News and analysis on generative AI, models, tools, regulation, and business adoption.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/security/): Coverage of threats, breaches, privacy, ransomware, and security best practices.
- [Cloud](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/cloud/): Reporting on cloud platforms, infrastructure, services, and enterprise deployment trends.
- [Data Centers](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/data-centers/): News on servers, storage, networking, and modern infrastructure operations.
- [Innovation](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/innovation/): Emerging technologies, research, startups, robotics, and future-facing industry developments.
- [CXO](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/cxo/): Executive-focused coverage of IT strategy, leadership, budgets, and digital transformation.
- [Developer](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/developer/): News and advice for software developers, coding tools, platforms, and workflows.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/digital-transformation/): Enterprise modernization strategies, automation, cloud migration, and operational change.
- [IT Priorities](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/it-priorities/): Coverage of enterprise planning, infrastructure investment, and technology decision-making.
- [Tech Industry](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/tech-industry/): Analysis of major vendors, market shifts, competition, and business strategy.
- [Networking](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/networking/): Enterprise networking, connectivity, wireless infrastructure, and telecom developments.
- [Storage](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/storage/): News and guidance on backup, storage systems, data management, and resilience.
- [Open Source](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/open-source/): Linux, open-source software, licensing, community projects, and enterprise adoption.

## Devices and Computing

- [Tablets](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/tablets/): Reviews and advice on iPads, Android tablets, e-readers, and accessories.

- [Printers](https://www.zdnet.com/topic/printers/): Buying guides and reviews for home office and business printing hardware.

- [Best Smartwatch](https://www.zdnet.com/article/best-smartwatch/): Tested smartwatch recommendations for fitness, productivity, and phone compatibility.
